primary_question: For a Cu/ZnO/Al2O3 methanol-synthesis catalyst directly exposed to H2S in the synthesis feed, what fraction of clean-feed methanol activity remains after a defined exposure under defined operating conditions?

counterfactual_precedence: same run and conditions immediately before H2S, corrected with an observed clean-feed aging trend
matched clean control at the same time on stream
paired baseline measured under the same reaction conditions
disallowed_denominators: an unmatched temperature, pressure, feed, or space velocity

observed_log_decay_rate_h_minus_1.use: secondary kinetic target only when exponential decay is supported and clean-feed aging is corrected or negligible

source_reported_h2s_coefficient.definition: the deactivation coefficient reported by the source using that source's stated equation and units
source_reported_h2s_coefficient.use: separate kinetic table; never pooled until equations and units are proven equivalent

strata.core_continuous_cuznal: Direct continuous H2S cofeed over Cu/ZnO/Al2O3 during methanol synthesis.
strata.continuous_other_cu: Direct cofeed over other Cu-containing formulations; supports catalyst-formulation effects but is not pooled with the core.
strata.ex_situ_damage: H2S pretreatment followed by a clean-feed methanol test; models retained catalyst damage, not instantaneous cofeed response.
strata.sulfur_loading_response: Activity related to measured catalyst sulfur loading when gas-phase H2S concentration or delivered dose is missing.
strata.guard_bed_protection: H2S is removed upstream; models protection performance, not direct catalyst poisoning.
strata.non_cu_expansion: Pd, In, or other non-Cu catalyst families.

evidence_tiers.A: Primary experimental source; exact numerical H2S exposure and methanol response; catalyst and operating conditions identified; matched or aging-corrected baseline; no unresolved duplicate.
evidence_tiers.B: Quantitative and useful but has one material limitation such as graph digitization, censoring, an unmatched initial point, incomplete operating metadata, or a protocol that requires a separate stratum.
evidence_tiers.C: Supporting evidence with a major confound or missing exposure variable, including guard-bed tests, cumulative stages with changed flow, or concentration-free sulfur-loading studies.
evidence_tiers.D: Mechanism, review, non-methanol reaction, mixed-sulfur field evidence, or non-Cu evidence outside the declared model stratum.

exclusion_rules: H2S cannot be separated from other sulfur species or co-contaminants.
The reported response is not methanol synthesis activity, rate, yield, productivity, or a validated normalized form of one of those outcomes.
The experiment is a simulation without a distinct experimental observation.
H2S concentration is missing for a concentration-response model.
Exposure time or delivered dose is missing for a time- or dose-response model.
The methanol response is selectivity alone and conversion or rate is unavailable.
A guard bed prevents direct H2S exposure of the modeled catalyst.
A row duplicates the same physical run already represented by a preferred record.

duplicate_policy.rule: Multiple papers, outcomes, or time points from one physical run share one duplicate_cluster_id and one study_group_id.
duplicate_policy.independence_rule: Multiple time points and outcomes from a run are not independent samples for validation or evidence counts.

aggregation_policy.allowed: Average only genuine replicates at the same catalyst, conditions, exposure, and outcome; preserve replicate count and standard deviation.
not_allowed: imputing missing study variables with a cross-study mean
averaging different catalysts, exposure modes, outcome definitions, or sulfur species
treating several time points from one run as independent studies

censoring_policy.rule: Store reported bounds as bounds, not point estimates.
censoring_policy.example: CO conversion reported as below 1% is left-censored at 1%; any derived methanol-output retention remains a bound.
censoring_policy.digitization: Store the digitized value, extraction method, and an uncertainty interval or sensitivity range.

uncertainty_policy.reported: Use source-reported uncertainty and replicate count when available.
uncertainty_policy.calculated: Propagate uncertainty from numerator and denominator when available; otherwise label uncertainty as unavailable.
uncertainty_policy.digitized: Use figure-resolution or repeat-digitization sensitivity; do not describe a digitized value as reported.
uncertainty_policy.model: Use study-cluster resampling or study-level sensitivity, never a random row split.

validation_policy.primary: Leave-one-study-out validation using entire held-out studies.
validation_policy.secondary: Leave-one-catalyst-formulation-out sensitivity when more than one formulation is modeled.

global_fit_gate.fallback_if_gate_fails: Do not publish a universal fitted curve. Implement source-specific kinetic calculations, bounded scenarios, and a transparent evidence-gap report.
